name: 90031 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90031 (Los Angeles) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90031 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90031 (Los Angeles) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
